/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead,form:0/1/3][help,form:0/1/3] Tower Formation
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead,form:0/1/2][harm,form:0/1/2] Assault Formation
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead,form:2][help,form:2] Guard
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead,form:3][harm,form:3] Battle Rush

title: Templar Pack
description:
• Rotation Helper
• Proc Tracker
• Missing Buffs
• Resource
• Cooldowns
• Spec Mechanics
• Trinkets
everything I considered important for Templar gameplay. From core rotations to passive tracking and defensive cooldowns .it's all in there
author: Bellaparry

title: Pyromancer Healer Missing pet
description: this weak aura helps you track your phoenix pet if it's missing. it also can help you resummon it if your pet die in combat.
author: Madee

title: Expulsion DoT and Mob Agro Counter
description: It shows how many mob hitting you and how many mob are infected with your Expulsion DoT. Its like "15/15" and has a timer under the counter that shows you how much time left for dots expire.
author: Cadoky / Halomancer (IG)

title: Bloodmage PACK
description:
Included in this pack:

    Buff / Debuff Tracker – Never miss an important aura.

    Spec Aura Monitor – Track your specialization-specific effects in real time.

    Passive Ability Tracker – All relevant class passives are covered.

    Howl Abilities – Full tracking for every Howl ability.

    Cooldown Management – Includes both core and general cooldowns.

    Resource Tracker – Always know your current resource status.
